markets.title: Upcoming markets
markets.intro: Fresh bakes, big smiles. We take cash and card. Get in early before the cupcakes run out!

about.title: Meet Maddy

photo.alt: Maddy holding two boxes of her bakes

about.p1: Welcome to Sprinkle Studios! I'm Maddy, an 11-year-old baker behind Sprinkle Studios.
about.p2: I've basically been baking since I could reach the counter, and I absolutely love making all sorts of goodies, like:
about.p3: Making people smile with my treats is my favourite thing to do!

order.title: Order something special
order.intro: Have a question, some feedback, or a cake idea for a special day? Don't hesitate to reach out. Tell us what you're dreaming of and we'll get back to you.

thanks.title: Thank you, people of Earth!
thanks.p1: Thanks for visiting! We hope you're leaving inspired to treat yourself.
thanks.p2: If you're craving more, get in touch. I would love to sweeten your day even more!
